trends.whatProductOffers: Core Accidental Death & Dismemberment cover with a client-set sum assured, plus a monthly Permanent Total Disability benefit of 1% of that sum assured for up to 100 months.

keyFigures.label: Core cover
keyFigures.condition: Sum assured chosen by the client

keyFigures.label: PTD payment
keyFigures.value: 1% of AD&D sum assured per month
keyFigures.condition: Starting from the 13th month; up to 100 months

keyFigures.label: PTD conditions
keyFigures.value: Age 18+, disabled within 180 days, 12 consecutive months

exclusionsOrConditions: PTD applies only to insureds aged 18 or above.
Disability must persist for 12 consecutive months.
No PTD payment if AD&D is payable for the same injury.
Sum assured is reduced after a payment.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Since {client_detail}, a permanent disability pays 1% of the chosen sum assured monthly for up to 100 months.
verificationPrompts: Ask what monthly income needs replacing
Check the sum assured the client can afford
sourceEvidence: "Each monthly payment equals to 1% of the sum assured of the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit add-on plan"

trends.whatProductOffers: Optional Accidental Medical Expenses Reimbursement and Daily Hospital Income covers can be added to the core AD&D plan.

keyFigures.label: Optional covers
keyFigures.value: Accidental medical expenses reimbursement + daily hospital income

exclusionsOrConditions: Optional covers may require additional premium.
Benefit amounts are not in the extracted text.
clientProfileFit: Clients wanting accident medical costs covered
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the optional medical and hospital income covers sit on top of the core accident sum assured.
verificationPrompts: Ask whether the client wants medical reimbursement
sourceEvidence: "Additional Optional Covers: Accidental Medical Expenses Reimbursement Benefit + Daily Hospital income Benefit"
trends.notesForReviewer: The extract gives no benefit amounts for the optional covers.

trends.whatProductOffers: A modular accident add-on where the client sets the AD&D sum assured and chooses which optional covers to attach.

keyFigures.label: Structure
keyFigures.condition: Optional medical expenses and daily hospital income

keyFigures.label: Sum assured
keyFigures.condition: Basis for AD&D and PTD benefits

exclusionsOrConditions: Must be attached to a basic plan as an add-on.
Sum assured is subject to underwriting and limits.
clientProfileFit: Clients with an existing basic plan
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Given {client_detail}, they can set the accident sum assured and add only the covers they need.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the client's existing basic plan
Ask what premium budget they have
sourceEvidence: "Set your own sum assured to suit your needs"
"Core Cover: Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit ... Additional Optional Covers"

trends.whatProductOffers: Doubles the AD&D or PTD benefit for covered accidents on public transport, in a passenger elevator, in a fire at a theatre, hotel, school or hospital, for a pedestrian struck by a vehicle, or in a flood or landslide in Hong Kong or Macau.

keyFigures.label: Covered transport
keyFigures.value: Ferry, bus, coach, train/MTR, taxi, airplane

exclusionsOrConditions: Elevators in mines or construction sites are excluded.
Fire must be in a listed venue.
Flood or landslide cover is limited to Hong Kong or Macau.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Because {client_detail}, the accident benefit doubles on the transport they use every day.
verificationPrompts: Confirm awareness of the listed events
sourceEvidence: "PAC Select 3 will double the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit or the Permanent Total Disability Benefit payable"
"a fare paying passenger travelling on marine, land or air public transportation"

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A modular accident add-on with client-set AD&D cover, monthly permanent disability income and optional accident medical and hospital cash benefits.
notSuitedWhen: The client needs a stand-alone policy
The client wants illness or hospital medical cover
The client needs savings or investment features
